LanguageData.CC_Shelf_ButtonDesc: Keep a slot on this shelf for each kind you pick, so there's always one stack of each the colony has. The other slots take anything the shelf allows.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_Explain: One slot is kept for each kind below while the colony has some on this map. Haulers fill the other slots with anything the shelf allows; when a reserved kind turns up and the shelf is full, a stack of what it holds most of is carried elsewhere to make room. The shelf's storage settings still decide what it may hold.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_Off: Reserved slots are switched off in Rimfolk's settings (Building page), or the deeper game hooks are, so haulers don't keep to these for now.
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_Coming: on the map, comes to the free slot
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_MakingRoom: on the map, a stack moves out to make room
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_NoneOnMap: none on this map, its slot is used meanwhile
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_RemoveTip: No longer reserve a slot for this
LanguageData.CC_Shelf_NothingToAdd: Nothing on this map that the shelf may hold and isn't reserved already
